Elephant - Electrophysiology Analysis Toolkit

[](https://coveralls.io/github/NeuralEnsemble/elephant?branch=master) [](https://elephant.readthedocs.io/en/latest/?badge=latest) [![![PyPi]](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/elephant)](https://pypi.org/project/elephant/) [](https://seladb.github.io/StarTrack-js/#/preload?r=neuralensemble,elephant) [](https://gitter.im/python-elephant/community?utm_source=badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=pr-badge) [](https://zenodo.org/badge/latestdoi/10311278) [](https://github.com/NeuralEnsemble/elephant/actions/workflows/CI.yml) [](https://bestpractices.coreinfrastructure.org/projects/6191) [](https://fair-software.eu) [](https://bsky.app/profile/pyelephant.bsky.social) [](https://fosstodon.org/@elephant)

Elephant package analyses all sorts of neurophysiological data: spike trains, LFP, analog signals. The input-output data format is either [Neo] https://github.com/NeuralEnsemble/python-neo, Quantity or Numpy array.

### More Information

Documentation: https://elephant.readthedocs.io/en/latest/  Mailing list: https://groups.google.com/group/neuralensemble

#### Visualization of Elephant analysis objects

Viziphant package (https://github.com/INM-6/viziphant) is developed by Elephant team for plotting and visualization of the output of Elephant functions in a few lines of code.
